title: fix(tui): keep the chat tail anchored when the thinking block is focused
body:
## Summary
- While the model is thinking, clicking/focusing the expanded reasoning block used `Widget.focus()`'s default `scroll_visible=True`. That centred the tall block and **released the `ChatArea` tail anchor**, so the viewport jumped up and never scrolled back — the model's answer appeared off-screen (la ventana "se va arriba" y no se ve la respuesta).
- Fix: route the box/click focus paths through `focus(scroll_visible=False)` and re-arm the chat tail in `ThoughtBlock._watch_collapsed` after a toggle.
- Adds a deterministic regression test that **fails without the fix** (chat jumps 90→53 and drops the tail) and passes with it.

## Test plan
- [x] `test_focused_box_expansion.py::test_clicking_expanded_thinking_keeps_chat_at_tail` — passes with fix, fails on `main`
- [x] `test_focused_box_expansion.py`, `test_model_reasoning_ui.py`, `test_chat_sequence.py`, `test_integrated_layout.py` — 18 passed
- [x] Full suite running in CI/local (isolated change to focus paths)

Confirmed root cause by instrumenting `Widget.release_anchor` in Textual 8.2.8 and reproducing the tail release via the real click handler.
